svg.title: Keeplight: brightness and resolution for every display
svg.desc: Keeplight's panel opens from the menu bar. Its brightness slider is dragged from 72 to 0 and the monitor dims, below its own minimum. Then 3008 by 1692 is picked as the resolution: the Keep card asks whether to keep it, its fifteen red dots go out one by one, and the resolution goes back.
